title: Scaffold Express app and run the health entry point
acceptance: WHEN GET /health is requested THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200 with body `{"status":"ok"}`.
WHEN the server starts with no PORT set THE SYSTEM SHALL default to 3000.
WHEN `pnpm typecheck` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0.
verify: node --env-file=.env dist/server.js & pid=$!; sleep 1; code="$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000/health)"; kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; test "$code" = "200"

title: Add tasks schema and apply it to a local Postgres
acceptance: WHEN `pnpm db:up` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL start Postgres and report it healthy.
WHEN `pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:migrate` run against the empty database THE SYSTEM SHALL create the `tasks` table.
WHEN `pnpm db:migrate` runs a second time with no new migrations THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 and apply nothing further.
verify: docker compose exec -T db psql -U app -d ai_academy -tAc "select to_regclass('public.tasks') is not null" | grep -qx t

title: Wire better-auth with the role and isActive fields
acceptance: WHEN `pnpm auth:generate` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL emit `src/db/auth-schema.ts` defining `user`, `session`, `account`, and `verification`, with `user.role` defaulting to `"usuario"` and `user.isActive` defaulting to `true`.
WHEN `pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:migrate` run after regenerating THE SYSTEM SHALL create `tasks`, `user`, `session`, `account`, and `verification`, all five.
WHEN `pnpm db:migrate` runs a second time THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 with nothing further to apply.
verify: docker compose exec -T db psql -U app -d ai_academy -tAc "select to_regclass('public.tasks') is not null and to_regclass('public.user') is not null and to_regclass('public.session') is not null and to_regclass('public.account') is not null and to_regclass('public.verification') is not null" | grep -qx t

title: Add login page, session middleware, and role guard
acceptance: WHEN GET /login is requested without a session THE SYSTEM SHALL render the login form with status 200.
WHEN a valid session cookie is presented to a route behind `attachSession()` THE SYSTEM SHALL attach `req.user` with its `role` and `isActive`.
WHEN `authorize("admin")` guards a route and a `usuario`-role session hits it THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 403.
WHEN no session is presented to a page route behind `attachSession()` that requires one THE SYSTEM SHALL redirect to /login.

title: Seed an admin user and add the tasks repository
acceptance: WHEN `pnpm db:seed` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL create exactly one `user` row with `role='admin'` and at least one sample `tasks` row.
WHEN `pnpm db:seed` runs a second time THE SYSTEM SHALL leave exactly one `admin` row (no duplicate on email).
WHEN `createTask({ title })` is called THE SYSTEM SHALL insert a row with `status` defaulted to `"pendiente"`.
WHEN `listTasks()` is called THE SYSTEM SHALL return tasks ordered by `createdAt` descending.
verify: docker compose exec -T db psql -U app -d ai_academy -tAc "select count(*) from \"user\" where role='admin'" | grep -qx 1
docker compose exec -T db psql -U app -d ai_academy -tAc "select count(*) from \"user\" where role='admin'" | grep -qx 1

title: Add Crear Tarea page wired to real task data
acceptance: WHEN an authenticated user GETs /tareas THE SYSTEM SHALL render the task list with status 200.
WHEN an unauthenticated request GETs /tareas THE SYSTEM SHALL redirect to /login.
WHEN POST /tareas is sent with a valid `title` THE SYSTEM SHALL create a task and redirect to /tareas with status 303.
WHEN POST /tareas is sent with an empty `title` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 400 and create no row.

title: Add filtros and cambio de estado to the tasks page
acceptance: WHEN GET /tareas?estado=completada is requested THE SYSTEM SHALL return only tasks whose status is `completada`.
WHEN GET /tareas?estado=bogus is requested THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 400.
WHEN POST /tareas/:id/estado sets a valid next status THE SYSTEM SHALL update that task and leave every other task's status unchanged.
WHEN POST /tareas/:id/estado targets a nonexistent id THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 404.

title: Add admin user management page
acceptance: WHEN an `admin`-role session GETs /admin/usuarios THE SYSTEM SHALL render the user list with status 200.
WHEN a `usuario`-role session GETs /admin/usuarios THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 403.
WHEN POST /admin/usuarios creates a user with a valid email and password THE SYSTEM SHALL create it with `role="usuario"`.
WHEN POST /admin/usuarios/:id/desactivar is called on an existing user THE SYSTEM SHALL set `isActive=false` for that user.

title: Add a centralized error-handling safety net
acceptance: WHEN a handler throws a `ZodError` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 400 with `{ "success": false, "error": <message> }`.
WHEN a handler throws `new HttpError(404, "...")` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond with status 404 and that message.
WHEN a handler throws an unexpected `Error` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 500 with a generic body, never the raw stack trace.

title: Add authorize() unit tests and run the full suite together
acceptance: WHEN `authorize("admin")` is called with a `usuario`-role actor THE SYSTEM SHALL call `next(new HttpError(403, ...))` and never call the route handler.
WHEN `authorize("admin")` is called with an `admin`-role actor THE SYSTEM SHALL call `next()` with no argument.
WHEN `updateStatus` targets a nonexistent task id THE SYSTEM SHALL return `undefined` and write no row.
WHEN the full suite runs via `pnpm test` THE SYSTEM SHALL report 0 failed and 0 skipped.

title: Add the end-to-end login-to-admin flow
acceptance: WHEN the seeded admin logs in via the UI THE SYSTEM SHALL redirect to /tareas.
WHEN the admin creates a task titled "Tarea E2E" via the form THE SYSTEM SHALL show it in the list with status `pendiente`.
WHEN the admin filters by `estado=pendiente` THE SYSTEM SHALL show only tasks with that status, including "Tarea E2E".
WHEN the admin changes "Tarea E2E"'s status to `completada` THE SYSTEM SHALL reflect the new status with no error on screen.
WHEN the admin creates a new user from /admin/usuarios THE SYSTEM SHALL list that user with role `usuario`.

title: Add CI workflow, README, and run the final gate
acceptance: WHEN `.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs on a push THE SYSTEM SHALL execute install, typecheck, lint, test, and build in that order.
WHEN README.md is read THE SYSTEM SHALL state the exact commands for dev, test, and db:migrate.
WHEN the global gate command sequence runs locally THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 end to end, including the health check against the built artifact.
verify: node --env-file=.env dist/server.js & pid=$!; sleep 1; code="$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000/health)"; kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; test "$code" = "200"
